core_obligations: Assume O_X -> j_*O_U injective and show that its restriction to any V etale over X is injective, so the scheme theoretic closure of U x_X V in V is V (proof lines 3534-3540).
Conversely assume the closure statement for all V and suppose O_X -> j_*O_U is not injective (proof lines 3541-3543).
Find an affine V = Spec(A) etale over X and a nonzero f in A mapping to zero in the sections over V x_X U (proof lines 3544-3546).
Conclude that the scheme theoretic closure of V x_X U lies in Spec(A/(f)), contradicting the hypothesis (proof lines 3546-3548).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an open immersion j : U -> X of algebraic spaces over S, U is scheme theoretically dense in X if and only if O_X -> j_*O_U is injective (source lines 3526-3532). The forward direction restricts the injection to any V etale over X and identifies the scheme theoretic closure of U x_X V in V with V; the converse argues by contradiction: if the map is not injective there is an affine V = Spec(A) etale over X and a nonzero f in A vanishing on V x_X U, so the scheme theoretic closure of V x_X U lies in Spec(A/(f)), contradicting the hypothesis.
